section_summary.extract_value: This Measures section describes the instruments and procedures used to assess key constructs in the study. It details the development of the Caregiver Eating Messages Scale (CEMS) with 19 items measuring pressure to eat and restrictive/critical eating messages, including a pilot test with 43 college students (12 men, 31 women; M age = 26.40). The section also describes measures for perceived body acceptance by family (BAOS), body appreciation (13-item BAS), intuitive eating (IES with 21 items), and BMI (self-reported weight and height). Internal consistency alphas are reported for women and men separately for most measures.
